items.q: And I remember George Brunies was in that band.

ctx.x: An awful lot has been made about jazz rhyhtms and the beat in jazz, etc. There's always a discussion of the rhythm (Pause) Okay, did you...did those rhythms, how similar to the tribal songs and the tribal dance rhythms did you find jazz rhythms to be? Did you find any similarity or did you find a great deal of difference? Or did you have any difficulty making the adjustment or was it something that you just loved and gravitated toward?

When I said at the beginning of this tape that I think everybody---every human being from days a long time ago---always had some kind of a rhythm and blues....(Pause) And when I think of the years that I spent in Chicago it was really the start of my induction into jazz music, besides the other facets of classical concert work that I did.
